Any extra keyword arguments passed by the caller are forwarded to the underlying constructor, allowing customization such as TLS options. Each newly created manager is stored in `self.proxy_manager` under the proxy key before being returned, so subsequent requests through the same proxy reuse the existing connection pools instead of reconnecting.
